welcome.title: A Bitcoin wallet only you control
welcome.description: Send and receive bitcoin over Lightning, right inside Evento. Your wallet lives on this device, and only you have access to it.

setup.title: Set up your wallet
setup.description: Choose a PIN to protect your wallet on this device. Back it up afterwards so you can always recover your funds.

selfCustodial.title: Self-custodial
selfCustodial.description: Evento doesn't store your wallet information. Only you have access to it.

pinProtected.title: PIN protected

recoverable.title: Always recoverable

beta.title: Beta Software
beta.subtitle: Important information about the Evento Wallet
beta.riskBody: The Evento Wallet is currently in beta testing. While we strive for reliability, there may be bugs or unexpected behavior.
beta.whatIsBetaBody: Beta software is feature-complete but still being tested. You may encounter bugs, performance issues, or unexpected behavior as we work to improve the wallet.

beta.practiceReport: Report any issues or bugs you encounter to help us improve

details.title: Transaction Details
details.satsTooltip: Satoshis (sats) are the smallest unit of Bitcoin. 100,000,000 sats = 1 Bitcoin.
details.feesTooltip: Network fees paid to process this Lightning transaction.
details.invoiceTooltip: A Lightning invoice is a payment request that contains the amount, destination, and other payment details.
details.paymentHashTooltip: A unique identifier for this Lightning payment, derived from the preimage.
details.preimageTooltip: The secret value that proves this payment was completed. It's the cryptographic proof of payment.
details.destinationTooltip: The public key of the Lightning node that received this payment.
details.transactionIdTooltip: The unique identifier for this transaction in your wallet.
